'''''Endings And Beginnings: An Autobiography''''' was an autobiography that was written by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Reglis Taal]]. Among the exploits detailed in the publication was a recount of Taal's [[Death/Legends|killing]] of the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Krestock]], who had been responsible for the death of Taal's brother [[Philo (Taal)|Philo]].
